message.content: According to the conversation, Saffron discusses Cersei's character development and her loss of children, suggesting that losing her children pushed Cersei over the edge. Saffron notes that "losing her kids really pushed her over the edge, didn't it?" and describes how Cersei embraced cruelty to secure her power as a result. This indicates that Saffron believes Cersei was blinded by her grief and the loss of her children, leading her to adopt harsh and ruthless behaviors. However, Saffron also questions whether Cersei was always this way, implying that circumstances may have made her behavior more extreme.
